arguments.prompt: Create one isolated Cartoon water effect for SPLASH.BMP frame001. First input is the exact original sprite: preserve its particular silhouette, proportions, relative positioning of parts, open transparent areas and number of significant tongues/drops. White source shapes are actual foam; black background is transparent and any dark diagnostic contour must not become dark water. Required form: A very wide LOW oval ring of broken white foam viewed obliquely on the water surface. Preserve the large transparent center, little holes and separated broken ripple marks left/right. The contour is irregular and flattened. No tall rising spray, no column, no thick solid blue disk. Second input is a shared water materials/style key ONLY, not pose or amount of water. Use clean luminous white foam, pale cyan/light-blue restrained cel shading and thin medium-blue contour accents. NO heavy black outline, navy shadow, dark cast shadow, dark puddle, gray haze or glow. No animals, ground, scenery, ocean horizon or text. Do not turn thin open source forms into a generic solid mound. Real alpha transparency in all background and holes. Complete shape and every droplet fully inside a comfortably padded canvas. Crisp smooth Cartoon artwork, not literal pixel art.
